task: observed cell lines, fixed 0.5 uM dose, globally unseen drug structure groups: low-observation control cell set (N=64) + drug structure -> mean delta RNA (2,000 genes)
row: one (cell line, drug structure group) condition
independent_unit: drug structure group (all of its cell lines together); cells, thinning seeds and training seeds are not independent samples

raw_counts.what_was_read: DMSO wells of the five plates that carry the 0.5 uM wells; treated cells were NOT read

condition_truth.definition: mean over cells of log1p(1e4*count/library) of the treated full well(s), replicate wells equally weighted

sources.r3_mapping: R3 cache wells.tsv (DMSO sample ids, plate/line indices) and its sampled control cells (used only for the cross-check)

control_roles.rule: eval_input = ranks [0,64); fit_input = next min(256, n-64-128); reference = rest; pool needs n >= 256
control_roles.order: blake2b(barcode) within a (plate, cell line) pool
control_roles.same_pool: eval_input, fit_input and reference cells of a pool come from the same DMSO wells: a within-condition sample split, not an independent-well replicate

truth.definition: Y_r6 = treated full-well mean - reference-control mean (input cells removed from the control term); identical at every p; never thinned

shift_vs_v2.note: Y_r6 - Y_v2: effect of removing the input cells from the reference control

truth.multi_plate: truth keeps the earlier plate weighting; the model input is the primary plate's pool

observation.thinning: Binomial(c,p) on each panel gene and on the out-of-panel sum; library = thinned total
observation.model_input_excludes: the keep-rate p itself (only observed library size / detected genes)

genes: frozen 2,000-gene panel (manifests/chemcpa_moe_v2/genes.tsv; chosen on v1 train responses only)

split.rule: one role per drug structure group across all cell lines (seed 20261112): 209 train / 70 val / 70 test
split.validation_drugs: not used by R6's own models

inputs_allowed: thinned integer counts of the pool's control cells (fit_input in training, eval_input at evaluation)
ECFP4 2048-bit fingerprint of the drug structure group
inputs_forbidden: any treated-cell statistic of an evaluation drug
the full-observation teacher output at inference
hcc: SNU-423 (CVCL_0366) is the pre-specified sub-table. HepG2/C3A (CVCL_1098) is marked as a separate origin and is not called adult HCC
caveats: train and test conditions share plates and DMSO pools
public benchmark already analysed by this project; not a blind cohort
no independent low-depth wet-lab data: claims are about synthetic observation reduction
Tahoe cells are shallow at full observation (median library ~1.9k UMI)
